metadata.name: Vibe Engineer NestJS / React / React Native Starter Preset

packages.name: domain
packages.boundaryRule: Pure TypeScript domain helpers only; must not import NestJS, React, React Native, Prisma client, api-client, UI, CLI, harness internals, filesystem/process, or app code.

packages.name: contracts
packages.boundaryRule: Owns schematic-generated ts-rest contracts and named Zod schemas; starter ships no demo contracts and must not import app code, Prisma client, UI, or api-client.

packages.name: api-client
packages.boundaryRule: Generated/shared client surface derived from packages/contracts; starter exposes only health endpoint names and must not duplicate schemas or define hand-authored CRUD DTOs.

packages.name: config
packages.boundaryRule: Env/config wrappers; no secrets in defaults; no app/api/Prisma/UI logic.

packages.name: testing
packages.boundaryRule: Test-only; no production package may depend on it.

packages.name: ui
packages.boundaryRule: Tokens/primitives/accessibility only; imports no app, api, Prisma, or api-client code; no routes, API calls, navigation, persistence, or domain rules.

layout.authStance: no-auth public health only until auth is generated

files.consumerNotes: Root strict NodeNext TypeScript baseline inherited verbatim from @vibe-engineer/preset-typescript compiler options.
Workspace globs for DL-16 apps/* and packages/*.
Starter Turborepo tasks derived from @vibe-engineer/preset-typescript turbo defaults.
Starter ESLint flat-config inheriting the consumed preset strict policy.
Starter Prettier config derived verbatim from the consumed preset prettier defaults.
Private root starter manifest for @olympiad-academy-app/workspace with strict scripts.
NestJS API app manifest with public health/readiness only before schematics add product modules.
API app tsconfig extending the strict root base.
React web app manifest.
Web app tsconfig extending the strict root base.
React Native mobile app manifest.
Mobile app tsconfig extending the strict root base.
Prisma-free pure-TS domain package manifest.
Domain package tsconfig inheriting the strict base.
Contracts package manifest for schematic-generated ts-rest + named Zod contracts; starter ships no demo contract.
Contracts package tsconfig inheriting the strict base.
Derived/shared api-client package manifest.
Api-client package tsconfig inheriting the strict base.
Env/config wrapper package manifest; no secrets in defaults.
Config package tsconfig inheriting the strict base.
Test-only testing package manifest; no production consumer.
Testing package tsconfig inheriting the strict base.
Narrow UI tokens/primitives package manifest.
UI package tsconfig inheriting the strict base.
Starter harness config: schema-valid v1 config with pi harness selection and explicit verification defaults; starter layout metadata lives in package.json/.vibe generated manifest, not config.
DL-17 neutral bootstrap context placeholder; declares no business domain, schema, demo data, or static stores.
Local PostgreSQL-only dev service (DL-16 database stance).
Generated preset manifest tying starter files to standards and consumed preset identity.
Default project-local verification runner catalog for common starter layers: typecheck, lint_format, unit, and build_package.
Node runner used by the default runner catalog to produce bounded local evidence for starter quality tasks.

rules.purpose: Strict TypeScript preset enforcement for no-fallthrough.

rules.purpose: Strict TypeScript preset enforcement for no-implicit-coercion.

rules.name: no-restricted-syntax
rules.purpose: Strict TypeScript preset enforcement for no-restricted-syntax.

rules.name: vibe-engineer/no-broad-domain-map-model
rules.purpose: Strict TypeScript preset enforcement for vibe-engineer/no-broad-domain-map-model.

packageScripts.quality:quick: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run build
packageScripts.rootQualityQuickCommand: pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && turbo run typecheck test:unit build

runtimePrerequisiteDiagnostic.authPrerequisite: Operator-managed local CLI authentication/subscription is required before any live model/runtime invocation; create/import do not perform auth probes.
runtimePrerequisiteDiagnostic.message: Pi CLI/auth/runtime unavailable for selected harness.
runtimePrerequisiteDiagnostic.missingBinaryMessage: Pi Coding Agent binary 'pi' is required for live harness runs; install it or select a supported installed harness explicitly. No Pi fallback is allowed.
runtimePrerequisiteDiagnostic.missingAuthMessage: Pi Coding Agent authentication/subscription is required for live harness runs; authenticate the 'pi' CLI before invoking a live runner. No Pi fallback is allowed.
